chronology.statement: This follow-up was designed after the outcome of the completed LF proximal motor recruitment experiment was observed. Static connectome, interface, encoder, and frozen-runtime information was inspected post-outcome to define observation populations. No neural execution of this follow-up occurred before this preregistration.

inherited_frozen_protocol.replay: unchanged parent LF proximal sensory replay
inherited_frozen_protocol.rng_semantics: inherit the frozen common-random-number semantics of the parent experiment without modification

interpretation_boundaries: Static anatomical reachability is not dynamic recruitment.
Failure to detect divergence at an observed stage does not establish biological disconnection.
Detected divergence in this modeled system does not by itself establish biological function.
No new motor decoder, coordinate sign, or physical motor contribution is assigned by this experiment.
This is explicitly a post-outcome mechanistic follow-up to the completed parent experiment.
non_goal: This experiment does not attempt to strengthen, tune, or otherwise modify the intervention to obtain motor recruitment.

post_outcome_static_observation_populati.candidate_motor_populations: exact previously preregistered candidate motor populations from the parent experiment; no additions or removals based on the observed parent outcome

complete_anatomical_one_hop_targets.definition: union of all direct postsynaptic targets of the 23 LF sensory source neurons in documented pre-to-post CSR orientation

runtime_admitted_one_hop_targets.definition: subset of complete anatomical one-hop targets receiving at least one LF sensory edge with synapse_count >= 6

post_outcome_static_observation_populati.selection_rule: Observation populations were defined from static frozen connectome/interface structure before any neural execution of this follow-up; no population is selected by follow-up activity.

primary_analysis_principle: Compare each intervention with its paired CONTROL_REPLAY branch within seed and localize the earliest prespecified observed stage showing condition-dependent divergence. Preserve per-neuron and per-seed measurements; population summaries must not replace the underlying per-neuron observations.
scientific_question: Using the unchanged replay, LF interventions, encoder, model configuration, RNG policy, branch point, seeds, and neural dynamics of the completed LF proximal motor recruitment experiment, determine whether LF_MIN_BOUND and LF_MAX_BOUND produce condition-dependent divergence from CONTROL_REPLAY at successive observed stages from encoded LF sensory drive through delivered LF sensory events, direct postsynaptic neural activity, and the previously preregistered candidate motor populations.
